description: This file defines a utility class 'Pools' that implements object pooling for performance optimization. It includes interfaces and classes for managing object pools, such as 'Pool', 'SimplePool', and 'SynchronizedPool', enabling reuse of objects to reduce garbage collection and improve efficiency in Android applications.

classes.name: Pools
classes.description: A utility class providing object pooling implementations through nested classes and interfaces.

classes.name: Pools.Pool
classes.description: An interface defining object pool management methods 'acquire' and 'release'.

classes.name: Pools.SimplePool
classes.description: A non-synchronized implementation of object pooling with fixed maximum size.

classes.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool
classes.description: A thread-safe, synchronized version of the object pool extending 'SimplePool'.

methods.name: Pools.Pool.acquire
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool if available.

methods.name: Pools.Pool.release
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool, indicating it can be reused.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.<init>
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the pool with a maximum size.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.acquire
methods.description: Obtains an object from the pool, returning null if none are available.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.release
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool if it is not already in the pool and has space.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.<init>
methods.description: Constructor to create a thread-safe pool with specified maximum size.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.acquire
methods.description: Thread-safe retrieval of an object from the pool.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.release
methods.description: Thread-safe return of an object to the pool.
